display_name.description: The human name for the agent, where name is the identity a caller addresses it by. It is bounded because a receiver displays it. Absent from an agent whose operator wrote none, which displays name.

icon.description: An emoji the agent asks to be drawn beside its name.

icon_url.description: An https URL of an image the agent asks to be drawn beside its name. It is decoration the agent asserts and nothing verifies, so a reader decides whether to fetch it: fetching it directly discloses every viewer to the host the card named, and proxying it buys server-side request forgery.

prompts.description: Things a person can ask this agent, written by its operator, for a reader to offer somebody who has not used it before. They are suggestions rather than the only prompts the agent answers. Absent from an agent whose operator wrote none.

notes.description: What the agent could not put on this card, one sentence each, such as an MCP server whose tools could not be listed. A tool missing from tools is then a source being down rather than a tool that was removed.

model.description: The model the agent answers a prompt with, as its own configuration names it. It is the name the agent asks for, often an alias rather than the dated snapshot that serves a call. It is bounded because a receiver displays it. Absent from an agent that answers no prompts.

protocols.description: Protocol namespaces the agent supports, e.g. io.choria.fisk-ai.v1.

telemetry.description: The agent exports traces of what it does.

telemetry_content.description: Those traces carry the conversation itself, not only its structure and timing, so a prompt sent here reaches the operator's collector.
